offers.name: Microsoft Surface Pro (OLED) Copilot+ PC 13" 1TB Tablet with Snapdragon X Elite/32GB RAM (2024) - Platinum - Device Only

reviews.quote: 16GB of memory isn't a lot when it needs to be shared (and even when I just had a lot of browser tabs open, 11GB would already be in use).

professional.notes: CNET tested the 16GB/1TB config; this 32GB twin directly answers its biggest criticism. Ratings inferred (+0.7 productivity, +0.5 ai_ml for memory headroom). SHARED-surface-pro.md.

praises: 32GB kills the line's #1 complaint — heavy multitaskers and devs report no memory pressure (BBY 4.52★/100)
OLED 120Hz + 1TB makes it a credible light creator tablet (photo work in Lightroom with big catalogs)
Battery still ~full workday; extra RAM costs no endurance
Fanless and silent; performance holds off-acadapter (CNET-verified family trait)
Best local-AI tablet of its generation — 45-TOPS NPU plus 32GB unified-style memory for small LLMs
complaints: Reg CA$4,049.99 sticker before sale is steep once the CA$400 keyboard is added
Still no headphone jack, still only 2 USB-C ports
DX12 gaming unchanged — RAM doesn't fix the Adreno driver/API weaknesses (CNET: 'Mixed graphics performance')
RAM soldered despite the replaceable SSD — you must buy right at checkout
Heat while plugged in under sustained load persists (CNET con, family-wide)

design_philosophy: The Pro 11 tier that fixes CNET's loudest criticism: 32GB of LPDDR5x so the Adreno GPU and heavy workloads stop fighting over 16GB. Microsoft's tiering makes memory the real upgrade axis on this line — same X Elite silicon, same OLED chassis, more headroom for multitasking and on-device AI.
rating_notes: Inferred from CNET 8.3 anchor on 16GB/1TB OLED (SHARED-surface-pro.md): +16GB RAM → productivity +0.7, creative_work +0.5, ai_ml +0.5 (memory-bound local AI), gaming +0.1 (shared pool). All other factors identical. BBY 4.52★/100 on this SKU matches sibling calibration.
